profile.headline: Software engineer at Meta
profile.summary: Specialties: Software development, web development, e-commerce, user experience, interface design, ETL, SQL, database architecture, requirements specification, UML, systems analysis.

positions.title: Labs Developer
positions.description: Selected to join the Red Cheetah Labs team to design and develop experimental and forward-thinking products and features.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developer on more than 50 software projects including e-commerce web storefronts, social networking websites, desktop software solutions, and point-of-sale systems.
Worked directly with clients, providing support and accepting feedback.
Produced requirements and design documents and clear, useful documentation.
Designed, developed, and delivered large projects on time working largely by remote and without direct supervision.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Designed various backend, web-based, administrative functions using Perl, DHTML, ASP, and Microsoft SQL. 
Lead developer in charge of the redesign of financialaid.tamu.edu (in use from Jan 2005 to Jan 2011), including underlying database-driven dynamic structure and web-based administrative back-end.

positions.title: Server Maintenance
positions.description: Responsible for the continued operation of over twenty mainframe computers.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Assisted in the development of virtual military training program, focusing on supportive Perl development.

projects.title: Identity Management Center (IMC)
projects.description: IMC is a fully hosted and managed (SaaS) white label identity protection portal that can be easily customized and launched with brand and style requirements, allowing your organization to have an unrivaled suite of custom identity protection services that you can market to your members and consumers — without the technology overhead.
